18b4b8.risk_area: General attack surface mapping and technology identification
18b4b8.evidence: Complete enumeration performed. Application is a static site served by Python's SimpleHTTP/0.6 (Python 3.12.10). No backend APIs, authentication endpoints, database connections, or server-side processing found. Only static HTML, CSS, JS, and vendor libraries (Three.js r170, GSAP 3.12.5, Lenis) are served. Directory listings enabled for /vendor/, /vendor/three/, /vendor/gsap/, /vendor/lenis/, /js/, /docs/.

41ac24.evidence: Directory listings enabled on /vendor/, /vendor/three/, /vendor/gsap/, /vendor/lenis/, /js/, /docs/ exposing full file tree and library versions. Server header discloses Python 3.12.10 and SimpleHTTP/0.6. No CSP or other security headers.

7ddb61.evidence: No Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers present in server responses. Server header reveals Python version.

0a3f92.evidence: Covered by vuln-0001 (Directory Listings Enabled). Version exposure is a consequence of the directory listing misconfiguration. No separate CVE confirmed for Three.js r170, GSAP 3.12.5, or Lenis.

history.evidence: Library versions exposed via directory listings: Three.js r170, GSAP 3.12.5, Lenis (version in minified comments). No known CVEs confirmed but versions are publicly enumerated.

846b2e.evidence: Path traversal attempts (`/../../../etc/passwd`, `/../../../../etc/passwd`, URL-encoded variants) all returned 404. Python's http.server normalizes paths and prevents directory traversal outside the serving directory. The specific control is path normalization in `http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler.translate_path()` which resolves paths relative to the working directory and rejects attempts to escape.
